message: the parsed tree holds a tag at offset 545 (`<span class="pct-widget__retry" role="button" tabindex="0">`), and the tag scan never found it
$reason: `tag-swallowed-by-an-expression` twice over: two blocks, each with a `<` in its condition, `count() <limit()` and `count() <cap()`, and a stop after each, a retry and an undo. The tag scan reads each comparison as a tag running on to the next `>`, and each span vanishes into the false tag before it; the parsed tree holds both. The refusal quotes the first tag the tree holds and the scan missed, the retry, by its offset and its opening tag: each case before this one held one such tag, so a refusal that quoted the last of them passed them all.
